reference.title: Dumbbell Sitting Good Morning (male)
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Hips, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace upright, lower with the brace, breathe out as you sit tall.
breathing.cadence: About 2 s down, short pause, 1.3 s up

prescription.load: User-chosen dumbbell, light; stop about 2-3 reps short of failure (RIR 2-3)
prescription.progression: Add load, then a pause at the bottom

cues.text: Sit tall on the end of the bench, feet wide and flat, one dumbbell held upright against the chest.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back, the chest moving down between the thighs.
Stop before the back rounds; feel the glutes and lower back working.
Squeeze the glutes and lift the chest to sit tall again.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to go lower
mistakes.fix: Stop where the back is still flat.

mistakes.mistake: Feet too narrow, so the thighs block the trunk
mistakes.fix: Spread the feet wide so the chest can lower between the knees.

mistakes.mistake: Rocking back off the seat to stand up the trunk
mistakes.fix: Keep the hips planted on the bench.

kinematics.norm: Trunk leans forward from upright to about 45-60 degrees with a flat back (clinical opinion)
Knees bent about 90 degrees, feet planted (clinical opinion)
Controlled, about 2 s down and 1-1.5 s up (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #951512, Dumbbell Sitting Good Morning (male), video (movement reference)
Vigotsky et al. 2015, effects of load on good morning kinematics and EMG activity (PeerJ 3:e708)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
The dumbbell load is your choice: pick a weight you can move with the form shown for every rep.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Low-back pain: use a light load and a short range; seek advice if pain persists.
modify: Tight hips: sit a little higher or spread the feet wider.
regressions: Seated hinge without weight, hands across the chest.

muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Less stretched than in the standing good morning because the knees are bent (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Less stretched than in the standing good morning because the knees are bent (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Extends the hips to lift the trunk from the forward lean.
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Extends the hips to lift the trunk from the forward lean.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Main mover here: with the knees bent the hamstrings are slack, so the back extensors and glutes lift the trunk; hold it flat (clinical opinion; barbell good morning erector spinae data in Vigotsky 2015).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Main mover here: with the knees bent the hamstrings are slack, so the back extensors and glutes lift the trunk; hold it flat (clinical opinion; barbell good morning erector spinae data in Vigotsky 2015).
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Adductor magnus helps extend the hips; the wide seat lets the trunk lower between the thighs.
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Adductor magnus helps extend the hips; the wide seat lets the trunk lower between the thighs.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Hold the dumbbell against the chest.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Hold the dumbbell against the chest.

phases.label: Sit tall, dumbbell at the chest
